net_assessment: SOUND SPINE, THREE LOAD-BEARING ERRORS, AND ONE OF THEM WOULD DESTROY THE OWNER'S SHAPE. Every one of the sixteen evidence lines exists and says what the report claims — I opened all sixteen. Fourteen are CONFIRMED verbatim (three carry off-by-one citation slips: placePrimitive :111 not :117, main.ts :528 not :527, controls.test.ts :4-6 not :3). The soft-lock mechanism is real and well argued: controls.ts:1063 is the gate, controlsCore.ts:119 renders the broken state forever, the carry is on the wire already so no protocol bump is owed, and the instruction NOT to relax buildLegality.ts:47 is exactly right and is corroborated by phaseSplit.test.ts:21. No proposed change breaks a SPARK_CANON.md ruling — §9b retaliation is untouched, §1's archived subsystems are named only as code paths and never as live mechanics, and no second stat scale is invented. What the report gets wrong: (1) 'nothing ever clears Carrying except a local pointer edge' is REFUTED — hunterLifecycle.ts:197 and botController.ts:596 are two more DROP_SPARK producers, placePrimitive.ts:569 is a third clearer, and the hunter's `catch (e) { console.error(...) }` at :202-204 is a textbook S182-lesson-7 tolerant default swallowing the precise throw (b1) targets; (2) fix (a) does NOT return the shape mid-gesture — ControlState stays AttractDrag, `mine` passes on a Free spark, `attractedId` exempts it from the rim-snap, so on the host seat the owner would see no change until he releases, and hostTick cannot reach the input layer to fix that; (3) the owner ruling is inverted — option (i) does not return his shape to the shared quarry, it DELETES it, because applyDropSpark re-stamps createdTick, reapExpiredFreeSparks kills un-escrowed Free sparks at 600 ticks, the pull that put it in his hand had its escrow cleared at pickup, and every gatherer is sheltered for the whole 45 s fight. Two smaller refutations: the (b2) 'local seat?' hazard is already discharged (three construction sites, all local seat), and ci.e2eLanes.test.ts pins tags not specs. Finally, the report should own more loudly that NONE of its three entry paths is triggered by the whistle and two are joiner-only — the BUILD→FIGHT edge is correlation, not the demonstrated cause, and a branch that ships (a) as the headline fix may well see this recur. RECOMMENDATION: split it. Land (b1)+(b2)+(b3) as the fix, with the hunter's catch and the two false docblocks in the same commit; take (a) and the return-destination question to the owner as its own brief with the 10-second TTL on the table.
